The new `as_index` tuple-index branch applies even under legacy semantics and `"multiindex"`, changing how tuple-valued timestep inputs are interpreted. For example, a network can contain snapshots `(2020, "x")` and `(2020, (2020, "x"))`: a plain tuple-valued Index containing `(2020, "x")` previously selected the latter as a timestep, but now is accepted as the former’s complete snapshot label. The `create_model` wrapper preserves that interpretation and passes different snapshots to the builders.
